name: La Habra City Council
agenda_text:
100 E. La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, CA
WHEN ADDRESSING COUNCIL PLEASE COMPLETE A SPEAKER'S CARD BEFORE LEAVING COUNCIL CHAMBERS
AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.
&
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.
Monday, August 17, 2015
06:00 p.m.
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.: CANCELLED
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Council Chambers
INVOCATION: City Attorney Jones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Councilmember Shaw
ROLL CALL:
CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT:
I.
PROCLAMATIONS/PRESENTATIONS:
a.
Proclamation recognizing September 2015 as Childhood Cancer Awareness Month in La Habra.
Ia CC Proc Child Cancer mo
b.
Recognition of the Special Olympics World Games Host Town Committee.
Ib CC Certs Special Olympics
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
CONSENT CALENDAR - CITY COUNCIL:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
Approve denial of claim filed by Vannes Oppenheimer for wrongful death.
III2 HR Oppenheimer Claim Agenda
3.
Approve second reading and adoption of ORDINANCE NO. 1762 ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA APPROVING MODIFICATION 14-10 TO PLANNED UNIT DEVELOPMENT 11-01 FOR A 12-UNIT RESIDENTIAL CONDOMINIUM DEVELOPMENT AT 306 SOUTH MONTE VISTA STREET, AS PER THE APPROVED PLANS AND SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS.
III3 CD Ord 1762
4.
Approve the countywide National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System Stormwater Program shared costs budget for Fiscal Year 2015-2016.
III4 PW NPDES shared costs
5.
Approve staff's recommendation regarding a request for "No Stopping" restrictions on Dexford Drive at La Habra Boulevard; and
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO _______ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING, AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON BOTH SIDES OF DEXFORD DRIVE AT LA HABRA BOULEVARD.
III5 PW Dexford Dr no pkg
6.
Approve staff's recommendation regarding a request for "No Stopping" restrictions at 1200 West Lorella Avenue, west of Idaho Street; and
a.
APPROVE AND ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. ________ ENTITLED: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA PROHIBITING STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING AT ALL TIMES ON LORELLA AVENUE WEST OF IDAHO STREET.
III6 PW Lorella Ave no pkg
7.
REMOVED FROM THE AGENDA.
8.
Authorize City Manager to execute a three-year extension to an agreement for animal sheltering services with Inland Valley Humane Society (IVHS).
III8 PD Inland Valley agrmt
9.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00102613 through 00102939 totaling $865,145.87.
III9 FAS Warrants 20150818
IV.
CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS REMOVED FOR SEPARATE DISCUSSION:
V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
1.
Duly noticed public hearing to consider an ordinance adding Chapter 15.69 titled "Solar Energy Permits" to the La Habra Municipal Code.
a.
APPROVE FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. ______ ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA ADDING CHAPTER 15.69 TITLED "SOLAR ENERGY PERMITS" TO THE LA HABRA MUNICIPAL CODE.
V1 CD Solar Energy ord
VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS:
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
1.
Consider staff's recommendations regarding Neighborhood Traffic Management Plans G, H, O; Project No. 1-TC-15 and to award contract to Hardy & Harper, Inc. for the construction of Neighborhood Traffic Management Plans G, H, O, Project 1-TC-15.
a.
Approve Plans and Specifications for Neighborhood Traffic Management Plans G, H, O, Project No. 1-TC-15.
b.
Award construction contract for Neighborhood Traffic Management Plans G, H, O to Hardy and Harper, Inc. in the amount of $77,000.00 and reject all other bids.
c.
Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Hardy and Harper, Inc. in the amount of $77,000.00 and authorize staff to issue a purchase order to Hardy and Harper in the amount of $84,700.00, which includes a 10 percent contingency.
VI1 PW NTMP Plans GHO
VII.
MAYOR'S COMMUNITY CALENDAR:
VIII.
COMMENTS FROM STAFF:
IX.
COMMENTS FROM COUNCILMEMBERS:
X.
ADJOURNMENT:
Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the foregoing agenda. A copy of the full agenda packet is available for public review at the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours or on the City's webpage at http://www.lahabraca.gov/.
Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Authority/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at 110 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, during normal business hours
In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.
